"""Build an editable environment with a six-second camera path; preserves existing scene contents."""

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))


def build(kind="forest", size=120, seed=0, style="day", cache=None, assets="cc0"):
    import bpy
    from mathutils import Vector
    from sets.builders import city, forest

    scene = bpy.context.scene
    started = time.monotonic()
    existing = set(bpy.data.objects)
    # This collection owns this invocation, so agents can move/delete an entire set.
    group = bpy.data.collections.new("Set " + kind)
    scene.collection.children.link(group)
    cam_data = bpy.data.cameras.new("Set flythrough")
    camera = bpy.data.objects.new("Set camera " + kind, cam_data)
    group.objects.link(camera)
    cam_data.lens = 28 if kind in ("forest", "valley") else 24
    cam_data.clip_end = max(1000, size * 3)
    scene.camera = camera
    scene.render.resolution_x, scene.render.resolution_y = 1920, 1080
    scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
    scene.render.fps = 24
    scene.frame_start, scene.frame_end = 1, 144
    forest_kind = kind in ("forest", "valley")
    for frame, t in ((1, 0), (144, 1)):
        y = -size * 0.36 + t * size * 0.38
        x = math.sin(y / 22) * 5 if kind == "valley" else 0.3 * math.sin(t * 2)
        z = (
            6
            if kind == "valley"
            else 1.8
            if kind == "market"
            else 2.2
            if forest_kind
            else 3.4
        )
        camera.location = (x, y, z)
        target = Vector(
            (
                x + (1.5 if forest_kind else -2),
                y + 28,
                z + (2.8 if forest_kind else 1.8 if kind == "market" else 7),
            )
        )
        camera.rotation_euler = (
            (target - camera.location).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
        )
        camera.keyframe_insert("location", frame=frame)
        camera.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler", frame=frame)
    # Blender's layered actions have channel bags; keyframes default Bezier, giving a gentle ease.
    scene.frame_set(1)
    result = (
        forest(size, seed, camera, cache, assets, kind == "valley")
        if forest_kind
        else city(kind, size, seed, style, cache, assets)
    )
    for obj in set(bpy.data.objects) - existing:
        if obj == camera or not obj.users_collection:
            continue
        # Source collections stay unlinked: only carrier geometry is visible in the set.
        if any(c == scene.collection for c in obj.users_collection):
            scene.collection.objects.unlink(obj)
            group.objects.link(obj)
    group["set_type"] = kind
    group["seed"] = seed
    group["style"] = style
    result.update(
        {
            "type": kind,
            "size_m": size,
            "seed": seed,
            "style": style,
            "collection": group.name,
            "camera": camera.name,
            "objects": len(group.objects),
            "frames": 144,
            "fps": 24,
            "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
        }
    )
    return result


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=__doc__,
        epilog="Example: blender -b --factory-startup --python build-set.py -- --type downtown --size 160 --style night --save downtown.blend. Geometry and emissive materials only; apply the blender-looks skill's look.py to add lighting/atmosphere. Size is the set width in meters. Existing objects are preserved; a named Set collection owns the new geometry. Camera is replaced as the active scene camera. Uses CPU-compatible native Blender nodes.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--type",
        required=True,
        choices=("forest", "city-block", "downtown", "street", "market", "valley"),
    )
    parser.add_argument("--size", type=float, default=120)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--style",
        default="day",
        choices=("day", "night", "rain-night", "neon"),
        help="Material/practical palette; lighting is separate",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--assets",
        choices=("cc0", "procedural"),
        default="cc0",
        help="CC0 cached undergrowth with offline procedural fallback, or entirely procedural",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--cache",
        default=str(
            Path(os.environ.get("XDG_CACHE_HOME", Path.home() / ".cache"))
            / "voyager"
            / "scatter"
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument("--save", metavar="BLEND", help="Save scene to this path")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not math.isfinite(args.size) or args.size < 24:
        parser.error("--size must be a finite number >=24 meters")
    result = build(args.type, args.size, args.seed, args.style, args.cache, args.assets)
    result["files"] = []
    if args.save:
        import bpy

        path = str(Path(args.save).resolve())
        bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=path)
        result["files"].append(path)
    print("BUILD_SET_JSON " + json.dumps(result))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1 :] if "--" in sys.argv else sys.argv[1:])
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - CLI boundary: report one line and exit nonzero
        print("build-set: error: " + str(error).replace("\n", " "), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

"""Scatter reusable CC0 models with native Geometry Nodes; no add-on or sign-in needed."""

import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=__doc__,
        epilog="Example: blender -b scene.blend --python scatter.py -- --target Ground --kit ferns --density 0.5 --save out.blend. Camera motion updates culling each frame; rebuild scatter after changing lens or render aspect. Sources stay instanced; source LOD meshes are simplified once. Density is points per square meter; use --distance 0 to retain all points (including off-screen shadow casters).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--target", help="Mesh surface name; defaults to active mesh")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--kit",
        default="forest-floor",
        help="forest-floor|ferns|grass|rocks|debris|leaves|trash|custom:<.blend/dir>",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--density", type=float, default=1)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--mask",
        default="",
        help="vertex group name, slope (under 40 degrees), or noise",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--avoid",
        nargs="*",
        default=[],
        help="Mesh names (space or comma separated) to keep clear of",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--clearance",
        type=float,
        default=1,
        help="Distance from avoidance mesh surfaces, meters",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--camera",
        help="Camera for live frustum/distance culling; defaults to scene camera",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--distance",
        type=float,
        default=180,
        help="Cull distance in meters; 0 disables camera culling",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--lod-distance", type=float, default=35)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--scale", nargs=2, type=float, default=(0.7, 1.3), metavar=("MIN", "MAX")
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--cache",
        default=str(
            Path(os.environ.get("XDG_CACHE_HOME", Path.home() / ".cache"))
            / "voyager"
            / "scatter"
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--save",
        metavar="BLEND",
        help="Save the scene (including packed assets) to this path",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if (
        not all(
            math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0
            for v in (
                args.density,
                args.clearance,
                args.distance,
                args.lod_distance,
                *args.scale,
            )
        )
        or args.scale[0] <= 0
        or args.scale[1] < args.scale[0]
    ):
        parser.error(
            "density/distances must be finite and nonnegative; scale must be positive MIN <= MAX"
        )
    import bpy
    from sets.assets import load_kit
    from sets.scattering import scatter

    started = time.monotonic()
    surface = (
        bpy.data.objects.get(args.target) if args.target else bpy.context.active_object
    )
    if not surface or surface.type != "MESH":
        raise ValueError("--target must identify a mesh surface")
    if (
        args.mask
        and args.mask not in ("slope", "noise")
        and args.mask not in surface.vertex_groups
        and args.mask not in surface.data.attributes
    ):
        raise ValueError("mask attribute not found: " + args.mask)
    avoid = []
    for name in [n for part in args.avoid for n in part.split(",")]:
        obj = bpy.data.objects.get(name)
        if not obj or obj.type != "MESH":
            raise ValueError("avoidance mesh not found: " + name)
        avoid.append(obj)
    camera = (
        bpy.data.objects.get(args.camera) if args.camera else bpy.context.scene.camera
    )
    if args.camera and (not camera or camera.type != "CAMERA"):
        raise ValueError("camera not found: " + args.camera)
    kit, provenance = load_kit(args.kit, args.cache)
    obj = scatter(
        surface,
        kit,
        density=args.density,
        seed=args.seed,
        mask=args.mask,
        avoid=avoid,
        clearance=args.clearance,
        distance=args.distance,
        lod_distance=args.lod_distance,
        camera=camera if args.distance else None,
        scale=args.scale,
    )
    obj["provenance"] = json.dumps(provenance)
    if args.save:
        bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(Path(args.save).resolve()))
    print(
        "SCATTER_JSON "
        + json.dumps(
            {
                "object": obj.name,
                "target": surface.name,
                "sources": len(kit.objects),
                "density": args.density,
                "seed": args.seed,
                "camera": camera.name if camera and args.distance else None,
                "instanced": True,
                "provenance": provenance,
                "files": [args.save] if args.save else [],
                "seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
            }
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1 :] if "--" in sys.argv else sys.argv[1:])
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - CLI boundary: report one line and exit nonzero
        print("scatter: error: " + str(error).replace("\n", " "), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

"""Camera-ready environment geometry. Lighting/atmosphere are owned by the look kit."""

import math
import random

import bpy

from .geometry import Mesh, ground, masonry, material, tree_sources
from .scattering import scatter
from .surfaces import scanned


def forest(size, seed, camera, cache, assets="cc0", valley=False):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    terrain, height = ground(size, valley)
    records, warnings = [], []
    trees, plants = None, None
    if assets == "cc0":
        try:
            surface, provenance = scanned("forest_leaves_02", cache, tile=3)
            terrain.data.materials[0] = surface
            records.append(provenance)
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
            warnings.append("CC0 forest surface unavailable: " + str(error))
    if assets == "cc0":
        from .assets import forest_trees, load_kit

        try:
            trees, provenance = forest_trees(cache)
            records.extend(provenance)
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
            warnings.append(
                "CC0 trees unavailable; procedural trees used: " + str(error)
            )
        try:
            kit, provenance = load_kit("forest-floor", cache)
            records.extend(provenance)
            plants = bpy.data.collections.new("Set fern sources")
            for specimen in kit.objects:
                if specimen.name.startswith("fern_"):
                    plants.objects.link(specimen)
            if not plants.objects:
                plants = None
            scatter(
                terrain,
                kit,
                density=0.045,
                seed=seed + 7,
                mask="vegetation",
                camera=camera,
                distance=65,
                lod_distance=22,
                scale=(0.5, 1.1),
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
            warnings.append(
                "CC0 undergrowth unavailable; procedural cover used: " + str(error)
            )
    if trees is None:
        trees = tree_sources(seed)
    scatter(
        terrain,
        trees,
        density=0.055 if not valley else 0.04,
        seed=seed,
        mask="tree_clusters",
        scale=(0.6, 1.45),
        camera=camera,
        distance=size * 1.1,
        lod_distance=30,
    )
    # Fern-like understorey remains useful offline; these meshes are instanced too.
    if plants is None:
        plants = bpy.data.collections.new("Set undergrowth sources")
        green = material("undergrowth", (0.12, 0.25, 0.04))
        for variant in range(3):
            mesh = Mesh()
            for frond in range(9):
                angle = frond * math.tau / 9
                for leaflet in range(9):
                    t = (leaflet + 1) / 10
                    x, y = math.cos(angle) * t, math.sin(angle) * t
                    z = math.sin(t * math.pi) * 0.5
                    w = (1 - t) * 0.3
                    for sign in (-1, 1):
                        mesh.polygon(
                            [
                                (x, y, z),
                                (
                                    x - math.sin(angle) * w * sign,
                                    y + math.cos(angle) * w * sign,
                                    z + 0.08,
                                ),
                                (
                                    x + math.cos(angle) * 0.14,
                                    y + math.sin(angle) * 0.14,
                                    z - 0.03,
                                ),
                            ]
                        )
            mesh.create(f"Fern specimen {variant}", [green], plants)
    scatter(
        terrain,
        plants,
        density=0.9,
        seed=seed + 5,
        mask="groundcover",
        camera=camera,
        distance=70,
        lod_distance=30,
        scale=(0.65, 1.6),
    )
    # Low ground layers fill the space between taller fern clumps without realizing instances.
    if assets == "cc0":
        for kit_name, density, scale_range in (
            ("forest-grass", 0.65, (0.45, 0.85)),
            ("leaves", 1.8, (0.08, 0.22)),
        ):
            try:
                cover, provenance = load_kit(kit_name, cache)
                records.extend(provenance)
                scatter(
                    terrain,
                    cover,
                    density=density,
                    seed=seed + len(kit_name) * 19,
                    mask="groundcover",
                    camera=camera,
                    distance=40,
                    lod_distance=22,
                    scale=scale_range,
                )
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
                warnings.append("CC0 " + kit_name + " unavailable: " + str(error))
    logs = Mesh()
    for i in range(round(size / 5)):
        x, y = (
            rng.uniform(-size * 0.42, size * 0.42),
            rng.uniform(-size * 0.45, size * 0.45),
        )
        if abs(x - math.sin(y / (22 if valley else 15)) * (5 if valley else 1)) < (
            6.5 if valley else 2.6
        ):
            continue
        z = height(x, y) + 0.23
        angle = rng.uniform(0, math.tau)
        end = (
            x + math.cos(angle) * rng.uniform(3, 6),
            y + math.sin(angle) * 4,
            z + 0.3,
        )
        if valley:
            start_bank = x - math.sin(y / 22) * 5
            end_bank = end[0] - math.sin(end[1] / 22) * 5
            if abs(end_bank) < 6.5 or start_bank * end_bank < 0:
                continue
        logs.beam((x, y, z), end, 0.22, 0, 9, 0.75)
        for branch in range(3):
            t = branch / 3
            p = (x + (end[0] - x) * t, y + (end[1] - y) * t, z + 0.1)
            logs.beam(p, (p[0] + 0.5, p[1] + 0.4, p[2] + 0.7), 0.05, 0, 5, 0.1)
    bark = material("bark", (0.13, 0.075, 0.038), noise=9)
    if assets == "cc0":
        try:
            bark, provenance = scanned("bark_brown_02", cache, tile=2)
            records.append(provenance)
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
            warnings.append("CC0 bark unavailable: " + str(error))
    logs.create("Fallen logs", [bark])
    stumps = Mesh()
    for i in range(round(size / 4)):
        x, y = rng.uniform(-size / 2, size / 2), rng.uniform(-size / 2, size / 2)
        if abs(x - (math.sin(y / 22) * 5 if valley else 0)) < (6.5 if valley else 3):
            continue
        z = height(x, y)
        stumps.beam(
            (x, y, z),
            (x, y, z + rng.uniform(0.3, 0.9)),
            rng.uniform(0.18, 0.45),
            0,
            11,
            0.85,
        )
    stumps.create("Broken stumps", [bark])
    return {"provenance": records, "warnings": warnings}


def text_sign(body, location, facing, mat, size=0.45):
    curve = bpy.data.curves.new("Shop lettering", "FONT")
    curve.body = body
    curve.align_x = "CENTER"
    curve.size = size
    curve.extrude = 0.008
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new("Sign " + body, curve)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location = location
    obj.rotation_euler = (math.pi / 2, 0, math.pi / 2 * facing)
    curve.materials.append(mat)
    obj["practical"] = True
    obj["practical_type"] = "sign"


def city(kind, size, seed, style, cache=None, assets="cc0"):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    records, warnings = [], []
    night = style in ("night", "rain-night", "neon")
    metal = material("iron", (0.035, 0.045, 0.045), roughness=0.4, metallic=0.7)
    concrete = material("sidewalk", (0.35, 0.34, 0.3), noise=22)
    asphalt = material("asphalt", (0.055, 0.065, 0.07), roughness=0.5, noise=55)
    lines = material("lane marking", (0.7, 0.64, 0.4), roughness=0.8)
    curtain_wall = material(
        "curtain wall blue glass", (0.06, 0.12, 0.17), roughness=0.22, metallic=0.55
    )
    dark = material("dark glass", (0.023, 0.055, 0.07), roughness=0.2, metallic=0.3)
    warm = material("warm windows", (1, 0.58, 0.25), emission=0.32 if night else 0.04)
    cool = material(
        "cool windows", (0.52, 0.73, 0.82), emission=0.13 if night else 0.02
    )
    amber = material("amber windows", (1, 0.36, 0.1), emission=0.75 if night else 0.08)
    white = material("shop lettering", (1, 0.82, 0.55), emission=2)
    lamp = material("lamp", (1, 0.7, 0.37), emission=7)
    walls = [
        masonry("facade " + str(i), c)
        for i, c in enumerate(
            (
                (0.28, 0.16, 0.11),
                (0.43, 0.39, 0.3),
                (0.19, 0.23, 0.24),
                (0.31, 0.32, 0.28),
                (0.16, 0.11, 0.08),
            )
        )
    ]
    if assets == "cc0":
        for index, asset in (
            (0, "brick_wall_001"),
            (2, "concrete_wall_006"),
            (4, "brick_wall_001"),
        ):
            try:
                walls[index], provenance = scanned(
                    asset, cache, tile=3, tint=(0.6, 0.45, 0.35) if index == 4 else None
                )
                records.append(provenance)
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
                warnings.append("CC0 facade unavailable: " + str(error))
    street = Mesh()
    street.box((0, 0, -0.16), (size, size, 0.3))
    street_surface = street.create("Streets asphalt", [asphalt])
    road = Mesh()
    for y in range(-int(size / 2), int(size / 2), 6):
        road.box((-0.15, y, 0.008), (0.12, 3, 0.02))
        road.box((0.15, y, 0.008), (0.12, 3, 0.02))
    road.create("Road center dashed paint", [lines])
    # Lots flank a central camera corridor. Cross streets subdivide long blocks.
    rows = math.ceil(size / 27)
    columns = 1 if kind in ("street", "market") else max(1, math.floor(size / 52))
    building_count, window_count = 0, 0
    for side in (-1, 1):
        for col in range(columns):
            x = side * (17 + col * 25)
            for row in range(rows):
                y = (row - (rows - 1) / 2) * 27
                sidewalk = Mesh()
                sidewalk.box((x, y, 0.12), (20, 23, 0.24))
                # paving joints and curb faces give the edge scale.
                for j in range(-10, 11, 2):
                    sidewalk.box((x - side * 9.85, y + j, 0.19), (0.2, 1.94, 0.36), 1)
                sidewalk.create(f"Sidewalk {side} {col} {row}", [concrete, walls[1]])
                for sub in (-1, 1):
                    bx, by = x, y + sub * 5.5
                    width, depth = rng.uniform(13.5, 16), rng.uniform(9.5, 10.7)
                    floors = (
                        rng.randint(4, 9) if kind != "downtown" else rng.randint(8, 24)
                    )
                    if kind == "market":
                        floors = rng.randint(3, 5)
                    h = floors * 3.2
                    structure, windows, frames = Mesh(), Mesh(), Mesh()
                    structure.box((bx, by, h / 2 + 0.25), (width, depth, h))
                    structure.box(
                        (bx, by, h + 0.45), (width + 0.4, depth + 0.4, 0.35), 1
                    )
                    structure.box((bx, by, 3.35), (width + 0.18, depth + 0.18, 0.24), 1)
                    for band in range(2, floors, 3):
                        structure.box(
                            (bx, by, band * 3.2), (width + 0.16, depth + 0.16, 0.18), 1
                        )
                    for roofitem in range(3):
                        structure.box(
                            (bx + rng.uniform(-5, 5), by + rng.uniform(-3, 3), h + 0.9),
                            (1.8, 1.4, 0.8),
                            2,
                        )
                    # Parapets, vents, chimney stacks and occasional water tanks break the skyline.
                    for sx in (-1, 1):
                        structure.box(
                            (bx + sx * width / 2, by, h + 0.85), (0.2, depth, 0.8), 1
                        )
                    structure.box(
                        (bx + width * 0.25, by + depth * 0.2, h + 1.5),
                        (0.7, 0.7, 2.5),
                        0,
                    )
                    if building_count % 4 == 0:
                        structure.beam((bx, by, h + 1), (bx, by, h + 3.4), 1.25, 2, 12)
                        for dx in (-0.9, 0.9):
                            structure.beam(
                                (bx + dx, by, h), (bx + dx, by, h + 1.1), 0.08, 2
                            )
                    for face in range(4):
                        # Facade local u vector and outward normal.
                        nx, ny = ((side, 0), (-side, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1))[face]
                        ux, uy = -ny, nx
                        span = depth if nx else width
                        radius = width / 2 if nx else depth / 2
                        count = int(span / 2)
                        for floor in range(1, floors):
                            z = floor * 3.2 + 1.55
                            for w in range(count):
                                u = (w - (count - 1) / 2) * 2
                                px, py = (
                                    bx + nx * (radius + 0.025) + ux * u,
                                    by + ny * (radius + 0.025) + uy * u,
                                )
                                lit = rng.choices(
                                    (0, 1, 2, 3), (0.78, 0.14, 0.06, 0.02)
                                )[0]
                                dims = (0.04, 1.16, 1.9) if nx else (1.16, 0.04, 1.9)
                                windows.box((px, py, z), dims, lit)
                                if lit:
                                    windows.emitter(
                                        (px + nx * 0.07, py + ny * 0.07, z),
                                        (nx, ny, 0),
                                        (1.16, 1.9),
                                        (
                                            (1, 0.58, 0.25),
                                            (0.52, 0.73, 0.82),
                                            (1, 0.36, 0.1),
                                        )[lit - 1],
                                        12 if night else 3,
                                        "window",
                                    )
                                window_count += 1
                                # Sills, mullions, curtains and dark interior-card silhouettes.

def material(name, color, roughness=0.7, emission=0, noise=0, metallic=0):
    existing = bpy.data.materials.get("Set " + name)
    if existing:
        return existing
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new("Set " + name)
    mat.diffuse_color = (*color, 1)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    shader = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    shader.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*color, 1)
    shader.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = roughness
    shader.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metallic
    if emission:
        shader.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*color, 1)
        shader.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emission
    if noise:
        tex = mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        position = mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
        mat.node_tree.links.new(position.outputs["Position"], tex.inputs["Vector"])
        tex.inputs["Scale"].default_value = noise
        tex.inputs["Detail"].default_value = 3
        ramp = mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = (*[v * 0.45 for v in color], 1)
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (*color, 1)
        mat.node_tree.links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"], ramp.inputs[0])
        mat.node_tree.links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"], shader.inputs["Base Color"])
        bump = mat.node_tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
        bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.25
        bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.08
        mat.node_tree.links.new(tex.outputs["Fac"], bump.inputs["Height"])
        mat.node_tree.links.new(bump.outputs[0], shader.inputs["Normal"])
    return mat

class Mesh:
    def __init__(self):
        self.vertices, self.faces, self.indices = [], [], []
        self.emitters = []

    def emitter(self, co, normal, size, color, power_w, kind):
        self.emitters.append(
            {
                "co": co,
                "normal": normal,
                "size": size,
                "color": color,
                "power_w": power_w,
                "type": kind,
            }
        )

    def polygon(self, points, mat=0):
        start = len(self.vertices)
        self.vertices.extend(points)
        self.faces.append(tuple(range(start, len(self.vertices))))
        self.indices.append(mat)

    def box(self, center, size, mat=0):
        x, y, z = center
        a, b, c = (s / 2 for s in size)
        start = len(self.vertices)
        self.vertices.extend(
            [
                (x - a, y - b, z - c),
                (x + a, y - b, z - c),
                (x + a, y + b, z - c),
                (x - a, y + b, z - c),
                (x - a, y - b, z + c),
                (x + a, y - b, z + c),
                (x + a, y + b, z + c),
                (x - a, y + b, z + c),
            ]
        )
        self.faces.extend(
            tuple(start + i for i in face)
            for face in (
                (0, 3, 2, 1),
                (4, 5, 6, 7),
                (0, 1, 5, 4),
                (1, 2, 6, 5),
                (2, 3, 7, 6),
                (3, 0, 4, 7),
            )
        )
        self.indices.extend([mat] * 6)

    def beam(self, start, end, radius, mat=0, sides=7, taper=1):
        a, b = Vector(start), Vector(end)
        direction = (b - a).normalized()
        side = direction.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
        if side.length < 0.01:
            side = direction.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
        side.normalize()
        up = direction.cross(side)
        rings = [
            [
                tuple(
                    c
                    + (
                        side * math.cos(i * math.tau / sides)
                        + up * math.sin(i * math.tau / sides)
                    )
                    * r
                )
                for i in range(sides)
            ]
            for c, r in ((a, radius), (b, radius * taper))
        ]
        self.polygon(list(reversed(rings[0])), mat)
        self.polygon(rings[1], mat)
        for i in range(sides):
            j = (i + 1) % sides
            self.polygon([rings[0][i], rings[0][j], rings[1][j], rings[1][i]], mat)

    def create(self, name, materials, collection=None, practical=None):
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
        mesh.from_pydata(self.vertices, [], self.faces)
        mesh.update()
        for mat in materials:
            mesh.materials.append(mat)
        for face, index in zip(mesh.polygons, self.indices):
            face.material_index = index
        obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
        (collection or bpy.context.scene.collection).objects.link(obj)
        if practical:
            obj["practical"] = True
            obj["practical_type"] = practical
            if self.emitters:
                obj["practical_emitters"] = json.dumps(self.emitters)
        return obj


def tree_sources(seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    collection = bpy.data.collections.new("Set trees sources")
    mats = [
        material("bark", (0.13, 0.075, 0.038), noise=9),
        material("pine shade", (0.025, 0.07, 0.022)),
        material("pine", (0.07, 0.15, 0.035)),
        material("pine tips", (0.13, 0.21, 0.055)),
        material("birch", (0.63, 0.64, 0.54), noise=13),
    ]
    for variant in range(4):
        mesh = Mesh()
        height = (11, 16, 20, 14)[variant]
        mesh.beam(
            (0, 0, 0),
            (0.12, 0, height),
            height * 0.019,
            4 if variant == 3 else 0,
            9,
            0.07,
        )
        for level in range(18):
            z = 1.8 + level * (height - 2.2) / 18
            extent = (1 - z / height) * height * 0.25 + 0.15
            for branch in range(6):
                angle = branch * math.tau / 6 + level * 1.73 + rng.uniform(-0.2, 0.2)
                length = extent * rng.uniform(0.65, 1.15)
                tip = (math.cos(angle) * length, math.sin(angle) * length, z + 0.3)
                mesh.beam((0, 0, z), tip, 0.035, 0, 5, 0.1)
                # Layered needle sprays: irregular silhouette, no alpha cards/overdraw.
                for sprig in range(7):
                    t = (sprig + 1) / 8
                    center = Vector((tip[0] * t, tip[1] * t, z + 0.3 * t))
                    side = Vector((-math.sin(angle), math.cos(angle), 0))
                    forward = Vector((math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle), 0))
                    width = (1 - t) * length * 0.27 + 0.08
                    for cross in (-1, 1):
                        apex = (
                            center
                            + side * width * cross
                            + forward * 0.24
                            + Vector((0, 0, 0.16))
                        )
                        mesh.polygon(
                            [
                                tuple(center - forward * 0.23),
                                tuple(apex),
                                tuple(center + forward * 0.4),
                            ],
                            rng.choice((1, 2, 2, 3)),
                        )
                        mesh.polygon(
                            [
                                tuple(center + Vector((0, 0, -0.18))),
                                tuple(apex),
                                tuple(center + Vector((0, 0, 0.27))),
                            ],
                            rng.choice((1, 2, 3)),
                        )
        mesh.create(f"Fir specimen {variant}", mats, collection)
    return collection


def ground(size, valley=False):
    from mathutils import noise

    mesh = Mesh()
    resolution = max(24, math.ceil(size))
    # Continue downstream beyond the camera corridor so the river never ends in view.
    rows = resolution * (3 if valley else 1)

    def height(x, y):
        bend = math.sin(y / 22) * 5
        if valley:
            bank = max(0, abs(x - bend) - 4)
            return (
                -0.5
                + bank * 0.22
                + bank**1.35 * 0.025
                + noise.noise_vector(Vector((x / 24, y / 24, 2))).z
                * min(bank / 8, 1)
                * 3
            )
        return (
            noise.noise_vector(Vector((x / 28, y / 28, 2))).z * 1.2 * min(abs(x) / 5, 1)
            + noise.noise_vector(Vector((x * 1.1, y * 1.1, 7))).z * 0.08
        )

    for j in range(rows + 1):
        for i in range(resolution + 1):
            x, y = (i / resolution - 0.5) * size, (j / resolution - 0.5) * size
            mesh.vertices.append((x, y, height(x, y)))
    for j in range(rows):
        for i in range(resolution):
            a = j * (resolution + 1) + i
            mesh.faces.append((a, a + 1, a + resolution + 2, a + resolution + 1))
            mesh.indices.append(0)
    obj = mesh.create(
        "Terrain valley" if valley else "Forest floor",
        [material("earth", (0.19, 0.135, 0.06), noise=14)],
    )
    for face in obj.data.polygons:
        face.use_smooth = True
    mask = obj.vertex_groups.new(name="vegetation")
    clustered = obj.vertex_groups.new(name="tree_clusters")
    cover = obj.vertex_groups.new(name="groundcover")
    moss = obj.data.attributes.new("moss", "FLOAT", "POINT")
    for vertex in obj.data.vertices:
        x, y, _z = vertex.co
        gap = abs(x - math.sin(y / 22) * 5) if valley else abs(x - math.sin(y / 15))
        mask.add(
            [vertex.index],
            max(0, min(1, (gap - (5 if valley else 1.1)) / 1.8)),
            "REPLACE",
        )
        plant_weight = max(0, min(1, (gap - (4.8 if valley else 0.65)) / 1.4))
        patch = 0.3 + 0.7 * (
            0.5 + 0.5 * noise.noise_vector(Vector((x / 9, y / 9, 4))).z
        )
        cover.add([vertex.index], plant_weight * patch, "REPLACE")
        moss.data[vertex.index].value = plant_weight * patch
        tree_weight = max(0, min(1, (gap - (5.5 if valley else 2.4)) / 2))
        cluster = max(
            0.05,
            min(1, (noise.noise_vector(Vector((x / 15, y / 15, 3))).z + 0.35) * 1.6),
        )
        clustered.add([vertex.index], tree_weight * cluster, "REPLACE")
    if valley:
        river = Mesh()
        for j in range(rows):
            y0, y1 = (j / resolution - 0.5) * size, ((j + 1) / resolution - 0.5) * size
            x0, x1 = math.sin(y0 / 22) * 5, math.sin(y1 / 22) * 5
            river.polygon(
                [
                    (x0 - 4.5, y0, -0.25),
                    (x0 + 4.5, y0, -0.25),
                    (x1 + 4.5, y1, -0.25),
                    (x1 - 4.5, y1, -0.25),
                ]
            )
        water = material(
            "river", (0.028, 0.12, 0.12), roughness=0.16, noise=2.5, metallic=0
        )
        shader = water.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
        shader.inputs["Transmission Weight"].default_value = 0.28
        shader.inputs["IOR"].default_value = 1.333
        for node in water.node_tree.nodes:
            if node.type == "BUMP":
                node.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.025
        river.create("River", [water])
    return obj, height

"""Native Geometry Nodes scatter. Source meshes are shared; no Realize Instances node."""

import math


def scatter(
    surface,
    collection,
    *,
    density=1,
    seed=0,
    mask="",
    avoid=(),
    clearance=1,
    distance=180,
    lod_distance=35,
    camera=None,
    scale=(0.7, 1.3),
):
    import bpy

    from .assets import lod_collection

    group = bpy.data.node_groups.new(
        "Voyager scatter " + surface.name, "GeometryNodeTree"
    )
    group.interface.new_socket(
        name="Geometry", in_out="INPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry"
    )
    group.interface.new_socket(
        name="Geometry", in_out="OUTPUT", socket_type="NodeSocketGeometry"
    )
    nodes, links = group.nodes, group.links

    def node(kind, label=""):
        n = nodes.new(kind)
        n.label = label
        return n

    def plug(value, socket):
        if isinstance(value, bpy.types.NodeSocket):
            links.new(value, socket)
        else:
            socket.default_value = value

    def math_node(op, a, b=0):
        n = node("ShaderNodeMath", op)
        n.operation = op
        plug(a, n.inputs[0])
        plug(b, n.inputs[1])
        return n.outputs[0]

    def vector(op, a, b=(0, 0, 0)):
        n = node("ShaderNodeVectorMath", op)
        n.operation = op
        plug(a, n.inputs[0])
        plug(b, n.inputs[1])
        return n.outputs[
            "Value" if op in ("DISTANCE", "LENGTH", "DOT_PRODUCT") else "Vector"
        ]

    def info(obj):
        n = node("GeometryNodeObjectInfo")
        n.transform_space = "RELATIVE"
        n.inputs["Object"].default_value = obj
        return n

    source = info(surface)
    position = node("GeometryNodeInputPosition").outputs["Position"]
    factor, visible = 1.0, True
    if mask == "slope":
        normal = node("GeometryNodeInputNormal").outputs["Normal"]
        factor = math_node(
            "GREATER_THAN",
            vector("DOT_PRODUCT", normal, (0, 0, 1)),
            math.cos(math.radians(40)),
        )
    elif mask == "noise":
        noise = node("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        plug(position, noise.inputs["Vector"])
        noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 0.2
        remap = node("ShaderNodeMapRange", "Noise patch coverage")
        remap.interpolation_type = "SMOOTHSTEP"
        remap.clamp = True
        links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"], remap.inputs["Value"])
        remap.inputs["From Min"].default_value = 0.35
        remap.inputs["From Max"].default_value = 0.7
        noise_mask = remap.outputs["Result"]
        probability = node("FunctionNodeRandomValue", "Point-domain patch density")
        probability.data_type = "FLOAT"
        probability.inputs["Min"].default_value = 0
        probability.inputs["Max"].default_value = 1
        probability.inputs["Seed"].default_value = seed + 67
        visible = math_node("LESS_THAN", probability.outputs["Value"], noise_mask)
    elif mask:
        attr = node("GeometryNodeInputNamedAttribute")
        attr.data_type = "FLOAT"
        attr.inputs["Name"].default_value = mask
        factor = attr.outputs["Attribute"]
    if avoid:
        join = node("GeometryNodeJoinGeometry", "Avoidance surfaces")
        for obj in avoid:
            links.new(info(obj).outputs["Geometry"], join.inputs["Geometry"])
        proximity = node("GeometryNodeProximity")
        proximity.target_element = "FACES"
        links.new(join.outputs["Geometry"], proximity.inputs["Target"])
        # Proximity must evaluate on distributed points, not the emitter's mesh vertices.
        visible = math_node(
            "MULTIPLY",
            visible,
            math_node("GREATER_THAN", proximity.outputs["Distance"], clearance),
        )
    points = node("GeometryNodeDistributePointsOnFaces")
    points.distribute_method = "RANDOM"
    links.new(source.outputs["Geometry"], points.inputs["Mesh"])
    plug(math_node("MULTIPLY", factor, density), points.inputs["Density"])
    points.inputs["Seed"].default_value = seed
    near = True
    radius = (
        max(
            (
                max((v.co.length for v in obj.data.vertices), default=1)
                for obj in collection.objects
            ),
            default=1,
        )
        * scale[1]
    )
    if camera:
        cam = info(camera)
        distance_field = vector("DISTANCE", position, cam.outputs["Location"])
        visible = math_node(
            "MULTIPLY",
            visible,
            math_node("LESS_THAN", distance_field, distance + radius),
        )
        near = math_node("LESS_THAN", distance_field, lod_distance)
        # Camera-space rectangle, conservatively expanded by the source bounding sphere.
        # Object Info is evaluated on every frame, including after reopening the .blend.
        relative = vector("SUBTRACT", position, cam.outputs["Location"])
        rotate = node("ShaderNodeVectorRotate")
        rotate.rotation_type = "EULER_XYZ"
        rotate.invert = True
        plug(relative, rotate.inputs["Vector"])
        links.new(cam.outputs["Rotation"], rotate.inputs["Rotation"])
        xyz = node("ShaderNodeSeparateXYZ")
        links.new(rotate.outputs["Vector"], xyz.inputs[0])
        depth = math_node("MULTIPLY", xyz.outputs["Z"], -1)
        visible = math_node(
            "MULTIPLY", visible, math_node("GREATER_THAN", depth, -radius)
        )
        frame = camera.data.view_frame(scene=bpy.context.scene)
        for axis in ("X", "Y"):
            i = 0 if axis == "X" else 1
            extent = max(abs(v[i]) for v in frame)
            if camera.data.type == "PERSP":
                extent = math_node(
                    "MULTIPLY", math_node("MAXIMUM", depth, 0), extent / abs(frame[0].z)
                )
            elif camera.data.type != "ORTHO":
                raise ValueError(
                    "scatter culling supports perspective and orthographic cameras"
                )
            inside = math_node(
                "LESS_THAN",
                math_node("ABSOLUTE", xyz.outputs[axis]),
                math_node("ADD", extent, radius + 3),
            )
            visible = math_node("MULTIPLY", visible, inside)
    delete = node("GeometryNodeDeleteGeometry", "Cull off-camera and distant points")
    delete.domain = "POINT"
    links.new(points.outputs["Points"], delete.inputs["Geometry"])
    plug(math_node("SUBTRACT", 1, visible), delete.inputs["Selection"])
    random_scale = node("FunctionNodeRandomValue", "Stable per-point scale")
    random_scale.data_type = "FLOAT"
    random_scale.inputs["Min"].default_value = scale[0]
    random_scale.inputs["Max"].default_value = scale[1]
    random_scale.inputs["Seed"].default_value = seed + 19
    spin = node("FunctionNodeRandomValue")
    spin.data_type = "FLOAT_VECTOR"
    spin.inputs["Min"].default_value = (0, 0, -math.pi)
    spin.inputs["Max"].default_value = (0, 0, math.pi)
    spin.inputs["Seed"].default_value = seed + 31
    choice = node("FunctionNodeRandomValue", "Stable source variation")
    choice.data_type = "INT"
    choice.inputs["Min"].default_value = 0
    choice.inputs["Max"].default_value = len(collection.objects) - 1
    choice.inputs["Seed"].default_value = seed + 47
    join = node("GeometryNodeJoinGeometry")
    for sources, selection in (
        (collection, near),
        (lod_collection(collection), math_node("SUBTRACT", 1, near)),
    ):
        c = node("GeometryNodeCollectionInfo")
        c.inputs["Collection"].default_value = sources
        c.inputs["Separate Children"].default_value = True
        c.inputs["Reset Children"].default_value = True
        instances = node("GeometryNodeInstanceOnPoints")
        links.new(delete.outputs["Geometry"], instances.inputs["Points"])
        links.new(c.outputs["Instances"], instances.inputs["Instance"])
        instances.inputs["Pick Instance"].default_value = True
        links.new(choice.outputs["Value"], instances.inputs["Instance Index"])
        plug(selection, instances.inputs["Selection"])
        links.new(random_scale.outputs["Value"], instances.inputs["Scale"])
        links.new(spin.outputs["Value"], instances.inputs["Rotation"])
        links.new(instances.outputs["Instances"], join.inputs["Geometry"])
    links.new(join.outputs["Geometry"], node("NodeGroupOutput").inputs["Geometry"])
    # Logical columns make the saved node group inspectable in Blender.
    for index, n in enumerate(nodes):
        n.location = ((index // 7) * 210, -(index % 7) * 175)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new("Scatter carrier")
    result = bpy.data.objects.new(
        "Scatter " + surface.name + " " + collection.name, mesh
    )
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(result)
    modifier = result.modifiers.new("Voyager scatter", "NODES")
    modifier.node_group = group
    result["scatter_seed"] = seed
    result["scatter_density"] = density
    result["scatter_kit"] = collection.name
    result["scatter_camera"] = camera.name if camera else ""
    return result

"""Packed CC0 scan surfaces; world-scale box projection also works without UVs."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from .assets import download, request
from .geometry import material


def scanned(asset, cache, tile=3, tint=None):
    import bpy

    folder = Path(cache).expanduser().resolve() / asset
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    metadata = folder / "surface-files.json"
    if metadata.exists():
        files = json.loads(metadata.read_text())
    else:
        with request("https://api.polyhaven.com/files/" + asset) as response:
            files = json.load(response)
        # Metadata is advisory; downloads themselves remain checksum verified and atomic.
        metadata.write_text(json.dumps(files))
    record = {
        "asset": asset,
        "source": "https://polyhaven.com/a/" + asset,
        "license": "CC0-1.0",
        "license_url": "https://polyhaven.com/license",
        "maps": {},
    }
    paths = {}
    for channel in ("Diffuse", "Rough", "Displacement"):
        entry = files[channel]["1k"]["png"]
        path = folder / (channel + ".png")
        download(entry, path)
        paths[channel] = path
        record["maps"][channel] = {"url": entry["url"], "md5": entry["md5"]}
    mat = material(
        "scan " + asset + (" " + str(tint) if tint else ""), tint or (0.25, 0.2, 0.12)
    )
    tree = mat.node_tree
    shader = tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    geometry = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeNewGeometry")
    scale = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeVectorMath")
    scale.operation = "SCALE"
    scale.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 1 / tile
    tree.links.new(geometry.outputs["Position"], scale.inputs[0])
    textures = {}
    for channel, path in paths.items():
        tex = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexImage")
        tex.image = bpy.data.images.load(str(path), check_existing=True)
        if channel != "Diffuse":
            tex.image.colorspace_settings.name = "Non-Color"
        tex.image.pack()
        tex.projection = "BOX"
        tex.projection_blend = 0.2
        tree.links.new(scale.outputs[0], tex.inputs["Vector"])
        textures[channel] = tex.outputs["Color"]
    color = textures["Diffuse"]
    if tint:
        mix = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMixRGB")
        mix.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
        mix.inputs[0].default_value = 0.45
        mix.inputs[2].default_value = (*tint, 1)
        tree.links.new(color, mix.inputs[1])
        color = mix.outputs[0]
    if asset == "forest_leaves_02":
        # Moss follows planted banks; the compacted winding path keeps its leaf-litter scan.
        attribute = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeAttribute")
        attribute.attribute_name = "moss"
        noise = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
        noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value = 0.8
        tree.links.new(geometry.outputs["Position"], noise.inputs["Vector"])
        multiply = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMath")
        multiply.operation = "MULTIPLY"
        tree.links.new(attribute.outputs["Fac"], multiply.inputs[0])
        tree.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"], multiply.inputs[1])
        moss = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeMixRGB")
        moss.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
        tree.links.new(multiply.outputs[0], moss.inputs[0])
        tree.links.new(color, moss.inputs[1])
        moss.inputs[2].default_value = (0.22, 0.42, 0.065, 1)
        color = moss.outputs[0]
    tree.links.new(color, shader.inputs["Base Color"])
    tree.links.new(textures["Rough"], shader.inputs["Roughness"])
    bump = tree.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value = 0.065
    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.65
    tree.links.new(textures["Displacement"], bump.inputs["Height"])
    tree.links.new(bump.outputs[0], shader.inputs["Normal"])
    mat["source"] = record["source"]
    mat["license"] = "CC0-1.0"
    (folder / "surface-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
    return mat, record

name: blender-sets
description: "Build big Blender sets (forest, city block, downtown, street, market, valley) with a camera path, and scatter scenery (plants, rocks, debris or your own models) on a surface. Use with edit-in-blender for large environments."
---

Both commands run in Blender (see [edit-in-blender](../edit-in-blender/SKILL.md) for finding it) and print `--help`.
CC0 models and scans download on first use into a local cache; `--assets procedural` builds a set offline.

- Big sets with a camera path: `blender -b --factory-startup --python <this skill>/scripts/build-set.py -- --type forest|city-block|downtown|street|market|valley --save set.blend`. It builds geometry and emissive materials only; light it afterwards.
- Scenery scattered on a surface: `blender -b <scene.blend> --python <this skill>/scripts/scatter.py -- --target <mesh> --kit forest-floor|ferns|grass|rocks|debris|leaves|trash|custom:<.blend or folder> --save out.blend`. Rebuild the scatter after changing the camera lens or render aspect.
